sloka: अथवा नौ ध्रुवं मन्ये मन्यमान: सुखोचितौ।वनवासमनुध्याय गृहाय प्रतिनेष्यति ॥ २.९७.२२॥
transliteration: athavā nau dhruvaṁ manye manyamāna: sukhocitau।vanavāsamanudhyāya gṛhāya pratineṣyati ॥ 2.97.22॥

translations.english: Or rather having thought of the adversities of dwelling in a forest and also by realising that both of us are accustomed to comforts, I think he has certainly come to take us back home.
